brief.t: START HERE: Pay Polo 4PL's exam-fee invoice for container EMCU8614105 now and email Erik the receipt so he can release the shipment and arrange pickup.

ACT NOW 1: Polo 4PL required the exam-fee payment yesterday to release container EMCU8614105, and the shipment is still held at the exam site. Erik, Polo, and Buffman are waiting. Send: Erik, payment is being completed now. I will forward the receipt today. Please confirm release and the earliest pickup time as soon as accounting clears it.

ACT NOW 2: TALOVA sent five new Amazon FBA label sets with a tight shipping window yesterday and separately identified five prior shipments still showing as not shipped. Marcello is waiting, while the earlier request for 500 additional lip balms and proof of delivery for 15,000 units is now 13 calendar days old. Send: Marcello, I have the five new label sets and the five shipments showing open. I am reconciling inventory and shipment status now and will send confirmed ship dates and tracking today.

ACT NOW 3: Roon Body's inputs were reported available, but Josh has waited 5 calendar days for the immediate 1,500-unit production timeline. Josh is waiting. Send: Josh, I am locking the immediate 1,500 unit run into the next available floor slot now and will send you firm start and completion dates today.

next: Recommendation: Release Polo's container first, reconcile and ship TALOVA second, then commit Roon Body's floor dates.
Displaced: True Revival's Agua approval remains unverified, but Magnolia fragrance was delivered and SOCRI confirmed 40 kg Silgreen G in U.S. stock; the live shipment holds above are more immediate.
Scheduled: 13 other verified operational follow-ups remain below the Act Now cutoff; the nearest overdue item is the Michigan annual report notice received yesterday.
Noise: 34 new Outlook messages were below the operational cutoff.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions remain signed out. Purchasing and Email were connected and received fresh requests, but neither had returned a fresh reply during this run. Missing data is not zero.
